summary: Treasury analyst with 9 years in cash management, foreign-exchange hedging and bank-limit monitoring for Gujarat manufacturers. Runs daily liquidity forecasts, negotiates working-capital lines with banks and keeps hedge documentation audit-ready.

details: Forecast daily cash positions accross 14 bank accounts with a 3-day variance ≤ 2.5%
Stood in for the Head of Treasury at monthly bank review meetings and recieved the lenders' covenant queries
Moved surplus cash into overnight TREPS and liquid funds within the board-approved counterparty limits
Executed foward contracts worth USD 48 million to hedge soda ash import exposure within ± 15 paise of the budget rate
Cut bank charges by 11% after renegotiating cash managment fees with 3 banks
Managed export bill discounting and packing credit lines of INR 210 crore for denim mills at Santej and Khatraj
Prepared the monthly interest-cost MIS for the CFO and the audit comittee
Tracked LIBOR-to-SOFR transition clauses across 6 foreign-currency term loans
Built a 13-week cash-flow model for two textile exporters in Ichalkaranji and Bhiwandi and acheived a weekly variance under 4%
Set up a weekly bank-balance dashboard for the two promoters in Google Sheets
Processed 40 outward remittances a day under FEMA guidlines
Reconciled the USD, GBP and EUR nostro accounts every morning before the 10:30 dealing window
Quoted daily card rates to 9 branches in Maninagar, Naroda and Vatva
Filed the daily forex postion report to the bank's head office before 5 pm
